title: Bike Race Network
summary: Cycling community and race management platform connecting riders, race organizers, and leaderboard tracking.
problem: Local cycling events lack centralized digital registration, live result updates, and rider community networking.
solution: Built a web platform allowing organizers to host cycling events, register participants, and publish race results.
features: Event registration and race participant profile management
Interactive leaderboard displays for timed race stages
Rider community feed and event announcement hub
